tha-ap332:1.1: Saparivārachattadāyaka.] Padumuttaro lokavidū āhutīnaṃ paṭiggaho / ākāse jalavuṭṭhīva vassati dhammavuṭṭhiyā. // //
tha-ap332:2.1: Tam addasāsiṃ sambuddhaṃ desentam amataṃ padaṃ / sakaṃ cittaṃ pasādetvā agamāsiṃ sakaṃ gharaṃ // //
tha-ap332:3.1: Chattam alaṅkataṃ gayha upagacchiṃ naruttamaṃ / haṭṭho haṭṭhena cittena ākāse ukkhipim ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap332:4.1: Susaṅgahītayānaṃ va danto va sāvakuttamo / upagantvāna sambuddhaṃ matthake sampatiṭṭhahi. // //
tha-ap332:5.1: Anukampako kāruṇiko Buddho lokagganāyako / bhikkhusaṅghe nisīditvā imā gāthā abhāsatha: // //
tha-ap332:6.1: ‘Yena chattam idaṃ dinnam alaṅkataṃ manoramaṃ / tena cittappasādena duggatiṃ so na gacchati. // //
tha-ap332:7.1: Sattakkhattuñ ca devesu devarajjaṃ karissati / chattiṃsakkhattuṃ rājā ca cakkavattī bhavissati. // //
tha-ap332:8.1: Kappasatasahassamhi Okkākakulasambhavo / Gotamo nāma nāmena satthā loke bhavissati. // //
tha-ap332:9.1: Tassa dhammesu dāyādo oraso dhammanimmito / sabbāsave pariññāya nibbāyissat' anāsavo.' // //
tha-ap332:10.1: Buddhassa giram aññāya vācāsabhim udīritaṃ / pasannacitto sumano bhiyyobhāsaṃ janes' ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap332:11.1: Jahitvā mānusaṃ yoniṃ devayoniṃ samajjhagaṃ / vimānam uttamaṃ mayham abbhuggataṃ manoramaṃ. // //
tha-ap332:12.1: Vimānā nikkhamantassa setacchattaṃ dhāriyati tadā / saññaṃ paṭilabhāmi pubbakammass' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap332:13.1: Devalokā cavitvāna manussattañ ca āgacchiṃ / chattiṃsakkhattuñ cakkavattī sattakappasatamhi 'to. // //
tha-ap332:14.1: Tamhā kāyā cavitvāna āgacchaṃ tidasaṃ puraṃ / saṃsaritvānupubbena mānussaṃ punar āgamaṃ. // //
tha-ap332:15.1: Okkantam mātukucchiṃ maṃ setacchattam adhārayuṃ / Jātiyā sattavassā 'haṃ pabbajim anagāriyaṃ. // //
tha-ap332:16.1: Sunando nāma nāmena brāhmaṇo mantapāragū / phalitaṃ chattam ādāya sāvakaggassa so adā. // //
tha-ap332:17.1: Anumodi mahāvīro Sāriputto mahākathī / sutvānumodanaṃ tassa pubbakammam anussariṃ: // //
tha-ap332:18.1: Añjaliṃ paggahetvāna sakaṃ cittaṃ pasādayiṃ / saritvā pūrimaṃ kammam arahattam apāpuṇiṃ. // //
tha-ap332:19.1: Uṭṭhāya āsanā tamhā sīre katvāna añjaliṃ / sambuddham abhivādetvā imaṃ vācam udīrayiṃ: // //
tha-ap332:20.1: Satasahasse ito kappe Buddho loke anuttaro / Padumuttaro lokavidū āhutīnaṃ paṭiggaho. // //
tha-ap332:21.1: Tassa chattaṃ mayā dinnaṃ vicittaṃ samalaṅkataṃ / ubho hatthehi paggaṇhi sayambhū aggapuggalo. // //
tha-ap332:22.1: Aho buddhā aho dhammā aho no satthu sampadā / ekachattassa dānena duggatiṃ nūpapajj' ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap332:23.1: Kilesā jhāpitā mayhaṃ bhavā sabbe samūhatā / sabbāsave pariññāya viharāmi anāsavo. // //
tha-ap332:25.1: Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Saparivārachattadāyako th. i. g. a-ti.
tha-ap332:29.1: Ummāpupphañ ca Pulinaṃ Hāso Saññā-Nimittako Saṃsāvako Nigguṇṭhī ca Sumanaṃ Pupphachattako Saparivāracchatto ca gāthā sattasat' uttarā.
